question: Does positive center migration work through first transition, continuation, closing location, or current center step? Does exiting only when cumulative migration reverses preserve continuation value?
exploratory_origin: EX051 center first events higher than all; EX052 center fixed3 improves return/DD vs ordinary close momentum, while distributed/close-high restriction loses money. EX052 center process lowers DD with reduced return. The distinctions below are new prospective checks of an observed lead, not independent confirmation.
comparisons: first vs continuation fixed3 versus existingC5202
above vs below center fixed3 versus existingC5202
positive current center step vs nonpositive current step fixed3
center reversal vs C5206 immediate failure exit

rules: All previous definitions unchanged. First=center_gain>0 and prior center_gain<=0. Continuation=positive today and yesterday. Above/below is adjusted close>=median intraday price or below. Step/pull partitions current center increment. Reversal exit=center_gain<=0. No same-day exit/reentry. Fees/time/cycle budget unchanged.
objectives: MANDATE/3 unchanged; stage2 complete prototype and conditional role evidence, center pass not full qualification.
limits: Selection after EX051/52 visible; no independent holdout; partitions are complementary signal groups but accounts are separately funded and need not sum. Late start makes BP comparison clearer but cannot erase early losses.
